hypotheses: Removing intention inputs while preserving DMS architecture and auxiliary updates improves return if conditioning hinders learning.
Joint RL gradients improve return if predictive priors are poorly aligned with policy/value objectives.
A separate ephemeral Walker update measures whether auxiliary feature refresh induces large policy drift.
limits: Single development seed, fixed 3M checkpoint. Do not promote a method or spend held-out seeds from these diagnostics alone.
